issues.legal_issue: A High Court cannot entertain review of an order after a challenge to that same order has been dismissed by the Supreme Court after hearing the parties.
material_facts: The High Court had rejected revision petitions, and the parties challenging that decision later sought special leave to appeal against the same order.
Both sides were represented and heard before the Supreme Court dismissed the special leave petitions.
After that dismissal, the High Court entertained review petitions concerning the same order, reviewed it, and ordered eviction.
The tenants appealed against the High Court’s review order.
issues.conclusion: The High Court’s review order was palpably erroneous and contrary to judicial discipline and propriety; the appeals were allowed and that order was set aside.
issues.legal_principle: After the Supreme Court has dismissed, following a hearing of the parties, a challenge to an order, the High Court cannot entertain review of that same order. Doing so is an affront to the Supreme Court’s order, subversive of judicial discipline, and an abuse of process. The judgment relies on no named earlier case or statutory provision.

rule.if: appeal_from_review_order and same_order_challenged_before_top_court and prior_challenge_dismissed_after_hearing and review_later_entertained

predicates.appeal_from_review_order: A party appealed against an order made by a lower court in review proceedings.
predicates.same_order_challenged_before_top_court: A party challenged before the Supreme Court the same order that was later reviewed by the lower court.
predicates.prior_challenge_dismissed_after_hearing: The Supreme Court dismissed the earlier challenge after hearing the parties.
predicates.review_later_entertained: The lower court later entertained review of the order challenged before the Supreme Court.

issues.definition: When an appeal challenges a review order and the same underlying order was challenged before the Supreme Court, which dismissed that challenge after hearing the parties, the lower court’s later review order is set aside.
